data.source: checksum-verified Binance Public Data USD-M Futures monthly 1h kline archives
data.missing_rule: feature unavailable unless all five members have exact fully closed bars at T and T-4; no interpolation, fill, REST backfill, or substitution

episodes.definition: maximal consecutive available hourly decisions with same extreme XAB4H direction

labels.reference: first canonical BTC 1m open strictly after onset decision close

h26.statement: Extreme cross-asset breadth episode onset contains directional information for subsequent BTCUSDT returns.
h26.support: 4h/8h signed medians and permutation deltas >0; bootstrap p05>=-0.05; Early/Late >0; LONG/SHORT>=-0.05
h26.falsify: both signed medians<=0 or both permutation deltas<=0

h27.statement: Cross-asset breadth contains incremental directional information beyond BTC own contemporaneous 4h momentum.
h27.btc_baseline: trailing BTC 4h return sign; positive LONG, negative SHORT, zero NO_BIAS
h27.support: XAB-minus-BTC paired delta >0 and week bootstrap p05>=-0.05 at 4h/8h, with stratified permutation deltas >0

h28.statement: Cross-asset direction provides directional information on the frozen exact-timestamp TP/BR opportunity union.
h28.state: latest fully closed extreme XAB4H state
h28.controls: non-pattern BTC decisions matched year, BTC ATR decile, XAB side, BTC MOM4H sign, >=24h, K=5 nearest
h28.support: pooled signed medians and matched deltas >0; signed and delta p05>=-0.05; Early/Late >0; LONG/SHORT>=-0.05
h28.falsify: both pooled medians<=0 or both matched deltas<=0

outputs: leave-one-out direction agreement and event-count change
